design: Replay source factorial; capture actual L2 post-normalization/RoPE Q,K,Q2,K2 and mixedV. Reconstruct first-source→second-source signed edge per head, project factorial interaction through c_proj. Remove one head interaction, all edge interactions, or full-module interaction at second-source output.
prediction: Frozen L2H5 should reproduce full-edge interaction-removal effects on a separate lexical panel; no head reselection. Measure all-edge reconstruction and per-example candidate/margin fidelity. Matching vs mismatching signed routing is descriptive, not proof of semantic equality.
limitations: Household panel previously used for task/site analysis but not H795 head selection. Same two formats; vocabulary differs. Only two identities per item, so no nonreceiver mixed-donor factorial cell. Partial native MLP-output substitutions remain hybrid states.
